title: Cloud providers
subtitle: Store a cloud provider API token to provision new servers that auto-enroll into Tugra.
howto: Create a Hetzner Cloud API token (Project → Security → API tokens, Read & Write) and paste it here. It is encrypted and never shown again.
name: Name
apiTokenKeep: Leave blank to keep the current token.
